notes.title: Patch for July 21
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Long time no updates. This is really small one. Vietnamese language added and traditional chinese texts are updated.

Cheers!

notes.title: Armory update!
notes.content:
New armory update is available now!

- New game mode: Armory. It's more about how do you use weapons. Also new achievements!
- New master fatalities. Check out sandbox and prove that you are true master of happy room weapons!
- Also fixes/improvements so game experience will be even better

If you want to get free copy of a game help us translate text for Armory update! Guiede how to do it:

https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791456620708/announcements/detail/261604288220380870

notes.title: 2.0 Dungeon update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! New BIG udpate for Happy Room is out!

- new game mode with new achievements!
- new weapons!
- hours of fun!
- fatalities now have voice actings, check them out!
- you can now save last 10 seconds to the gif, try it out!

Many bugs were fixed and hopefuly not many new were added : D
If you'll find any please share them here in this cummunity we will do our best to fix them as soon as possible.

Steam workshop now correctly uploads all your rooms from subscriptions.

Also! There are new texts in game, if you want to help with game tranlation and get some free copies of a game and also be in game credits please follow this link: https://steamcommunity.com/games/550010/announcements/detail/261604288220380870

If you find a bug please follow these steps: https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791456620708/announcements/detail/248095310204522063

Cheers!

notes.title: 1.1.0 Workshop testing!
notes.content:
Hi!

1.1.0 version with workshop and save/load room feature is now live in test brach. You will be able to upload your room setups to steam and share it with other steam users. It is still in testing so it may be some bugs in it. If you will find them just write them in the comments.

Guide how to switch to debug version: 
http://steamcommunity.com/games/550010/announcements/detail/248095310204522063

To share you room setup to steam just save your room:

[img=http://manapotionstudios.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/new-room.png][/img]

And then from load menu:

[img=http://manapotionstudios.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/select.png][/img]

share it to steam:

[img=http://manapotionstudios.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/share.png][/img]

[img=http://manapotionstudios.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/check.png][/img]

After room will be uploaded you will be redirected to it's page, room preview will update in few minutes. Make sure that you accepted Steam Subscriber Agreement, or your submissions will not be visible to other users:

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/workshoplegalagreement

Check out other player rooms:

http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=550010&browsesort=mostrecent&section=readytouseitems&actualsort=mostrecent&p=1

Just subscribe on some of them, restart a game and these rooms will appear
in Cloud tab in load room menu:

[img=http://manapotionstudios.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/cloud.png][/img]

notes.title: 1.0.5 update!
notes.content:
You requested it so many time and It is finaly here!

Upgrades reset and game reset is live with this update. Upgrades reset button can be found in upgrades menu:

[img=http://manapotionstudios.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/happy_room_reset_upgrades.png] 	[/img]

You can reset upgrades for each category, all weapons of this category will be deleted from scene after you will reset them.

Also you now can delete game progress from main menu: 

[img=http://manapotionstudios.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/reset_game.png][/img]

Just a nice addition, you can now see your story and sandbox progress in main menu too:

[img=http://manapotionstudios.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/sandbox_help.png][/img]

Linux version update will be live on next week.

Will work on dummy customizations, room saves and room sharing by steam workshop now! If you will find new bugs please share them game discussions: http://steamcommunity.com/app/550010/discussions/

notes.title: Reset progress and more
notes.content:
As reset progress cause many problems and bugs, we removed it for now. It will be back when we rework it completely so you can replay story mode with different tactics. So please wait for next update, we will try to add steam workshop for rooms sharing in it, rooms saves / loads and more.

Also some gameplay fixes in this update:
- monsters deal 12 damage now, not 20
- piranhas do 2 times more damage
- fixed bug with exploding jumpers
- deathray do more damage


We did not expect such popularity of our game, so thank you all for playing it! We will continue to support and update it.

notes.title: 1.0.3 Update!
notes.content:
New update is live! Thing done:
- Game progress reset button added!
- fixed bug with only "Half" Steam achievement unlocking
- Also some minor bugs fixed
- Added feature for continuous weapons placement. Just hold mouse down while placing some weapon.
- Added axis lock feature. Hold left shift to place weapons on in horizontal or in vertical lines. Works for central placement.
- Also added Dutch language and fixed German and English, thanks to Twan Schoenmakers and Gabriel Selinschek : )
- Also there is zoom mode, press Z in game. But it is in beta mode, not polished yet.

In next update we will try to add steam workshop for sandbox rooms sharing.

notes.title: Game ideas for update?
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

What would you like to see in game update? Just leave a line and we may add it!

Some ideas that have been posted and we thought about:
- game progress reset
- workshop sharing of room setups
- continuous weapons placement while mouse down
- dummy skins / modifications
- Possibility to add delays to each weapon when it will begin to shot / work
- more scenes / custom scenes
- funny dummy hats
- more weapons / custom weapons
- controlling weapon with a mouse, for example crossbow. Aim and shoot when you like.
- locked aim or programmed activations, like for grenade launcher. Aim it at some angle and it will just shoot there.

Suggest your ideas in comments!

notes.title: Localization update!
notes.content:
We did not expect that so many of you would like to translate a game to new language!

Thanks to everyone that contacted us with this!

And it is already 3 new languages made by player for player in game, it is:

-Portuguese brazil
-Swedish
-Korean

Also we added Polish language. And it is Hungarian, Czech and Dutch still being translated. We hope that we will see them in game soon!

There are still some languages missing in game, so we still need some help. Our google doc texts are here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1pZxjC4LJ-jFXzT0FlHdEmWPfgrUEnPCrReyhDiFulQ0/edit#gid=0

Everyone who will help will get some free copies of a game and a line in credits : )

Thank you all!
